title: Map-canvas governed editing and read-only OGC Features compatibility

source.description: Checksum-pinned local evidence for bounded single-or-multipart map-canvas capture, exact-junction line-part split/merge, polygon-ring removal, schema fields, expected-version persistence, official OGC Features response schemas, and a native GDAL OAPIF read.

expectedOutcomes.assertion: The standalone browser draws all six point/line/polygon single-or-multipart families on a request-free spatial canvas, selects stable features and multipart components, performs bounded vertex, ring, and exact-junction line-part edits, edits typed fields, and persists through the existing expected-version audit boundary.

An authorized managed vector dataset can be captured and structurally edited through typed browser controls without GeoNode, while leaving broader/shared-edge topology, offline updates, attachments, and upstream migration explicit.
The same authoritative feature heads project through an authenticated read-only, schema-compatible OGC API Features-shaped endpoint consumed by GDAL, without claiming conformance or WFS/WFS-T parity.

Browser draw, part selection, bounded structure changes including line-part split/merge and hole removal, snapping, and vertex-modify outcomes are executable locally, while rendered structural-editing acceptance, full accessibility/device coverage, and a matching independent OpenLayers implementation remain open.
A source-locked Features 1.0 GeoJSON projection passes official response schemas and a native GDAL OAPIF read, while the wider protocol/client matrix remains open.
